hypotheses.claim: A burden-threshold risk model can flag life-threatening windows before clinical presentation.
Screening sensitivity gains monotonically reduce detection lag and risk score.
Protective interventions outweigh modifiable risk burden when biological aging accelerates.
Genomic classification match drives durable residual-disease clearance.
Resistance accumulates monotonically when immune engagement wanes.
Pathway blockade above a seeding threshold halts metastatic colonization.
Clonal diversity predicts treatment-failure risk independent of dominant clone.
ADC selectivity trades efficacy against off-target toxicity and quality of life.
Interoperability is the binding constraint on AI diagnostic accuracy.
Outreach narrows access gap faster than screening-rate gains alone.
Manufacturing scale gates population-level survival gains more than discovery maturity.
Stress load above an adaptation ceiling predicts development stagnation.
Validation coverage is the dominant driver of decision usefulness.
Fatigue crosses a threshold before injury-risk window opens.
Recovery half-life shortens as stress toxicity rises.
Trait fidelity decays across sport gaps but recovers with adaptation training.
Cognitive fatigue degrades decision quality before reaction time collapses.
Contract risk is more sensitive to injury probability than to performance value.
Punch-impact load drives head-trauma accumulation faster than fatigue toxicity.
Data coverage is the binding constraint on universal-model maturity.
Injury susceptibility decays career longevity faster than age.
Standardization resolves sensor conflict faster than protocol variance.
